subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: Must this provider-backed WeChat hot-reload fix show a redacted live account-A-plus-account-B QR-login handoff before merge, or is the focused gateway lifecycle evidence sufficient?
rationale: The contributor has repaired the source-level edge cases but cannot access an approved real WeChat setup; only gateway ownership can set the proof threshold for this provider-specific behavior.

options.title: Require live WeChat proof
options.body: Wait for a redacted live account-A-plus-account-B QR-login run showing account A remains online after account B triggers the reload handoff.

options.title: Accept gateway proof
options.body: Explicitly waive provider-level proof and merge based on the targeted lifecycle regressions, type checks, lint, build, and normal merge gates.

recommendation.title: Require live WeChat proof
recommendation.body: Wait for a redacted live account-A-plus-account-B QR-login run showing account A remains online after account B triggers the reload handoff.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision concerns the gateway reload proof threshold, and joshavant is a named gateway review contact in the PR timeline.
